book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: God i meke strong griment wea Noa
God i bin blese Noa ane ol boi blo em. Em bin spik diskain, ‘Yupla ol kam plenti ane meke plenti pikinini po stap ebriwea ya lo ert.
Ebri wailanimal, ebri pizin, ane ebridem pis blo solwata, ebriting wea i stap ane wagbaut antap lo graun, i go prapa prait prom yupla. Yupla gobi bos blo ebridem samting.
Ebri laip animal i gobi kaikai blo yupla, seimkain wiskain ai bin gibe yupla ebri sid ane bezdabol po kaikai.
Bat, da wan samting wea yupla mas no kaikai, i eni mit i gad blad i pas. Ai no wande yupla po kaikai diswan bikoz i gad laip insaid lo da blad.
Ane God i kip spik po dempla, ‘Wan man mas no kile nada man. Ip animal i kile man, den kile da animal. Ane ip wan man i kile nada man, den kile dat man.
Wa. Eni man uda i kile nada man, den dat man mas ded, bikoz God bin meke ebri pipol i gad imiz blo em.
Ane yu mas kam plenti ane gad plenti pikinini, solong ol pamlelain blo yupla go stap ebriwea lo ert.’
Den God i bin tok gen po Noa ane ol boi blo em diskain,
‘Diskaintaim ai meke strong griment blo mi wea yupla ane wea ol pamlelain blo yupla,
ane wea ebri laipsamting blo yupla, ebridem olkain pizin ane ebridem olkain teimanimal ane ebridem wailanimal, ane ebridem animal wea i bin kamaut prom da bot wea yupla.
Wa! Dem tok ya ai spik, ai go meke strong griment blo mi wea yupla. Ai promis ai nomo go sane prapa big pladwata po tekemaute laip prom ebri laipsamting wea lan, ane po nomo gen distroi ert.’
God i spik diskain, ‘Diswan i sain wea ai go kipe dis strong griment wea ai mekem wea yupla, ane wea ebri laipsamting poeba:
Ai go pute reinbou blo mi wea klaud. I gobi sain blo da strong griment blo mi wea ai bin mekem melen lo mi ane ert.
Ebritaim wen ai kabare skai wea klaud, reinbou go soe emselp,
ane ai go tingbaut strong griment melen lo mi ane yupla ane ebri laip animal. Da big pladwata i nomo go kam gen ane tekemaute laip prom ebri laipsamting.
Wen ai go luk reinbou wea dem klaud, ai go tingbaut da strong griment wea i go poeba melen God ane ebri laipsamting wea ert.’
God i spik po Noa, ‘Wa. Dis reinbou i sain blo da strong griment ai mekem melen lo mi ane ebridem laipsamting wea i stap lo ert.’
Dem boi blo Noa
Dem boi blo Noa wea ol i bin kam ausaid prom da bot i bin Sem, Am ane Zapet. Wa. Am i bin bigate blo dem pipol blo Kanan.
Prom demtri boi blo Noa ya, ebri pipol blo da lan i bin kamaut, ane ol i bin go ebriwei lo ert.
Wen da bigplad i bin pinis, Noa i bin stat wok wase pama, ane em i meke gadan, plante ol greipbain.
Wantaim, em bin dringk wain ane em bin kam spak, ane em bin leidaun neketwan insaid tent blo em.
Am, bigate blo dem pipol blo Kanan, bin luk papa blo em bin neketwan. Em bin go ausaid prom da tent ane em bin spik po demtu bala blo em.

Den Sem ane Zapet i bin teke kaliko ane bin kesem putem antap wea solda blo demtu, ane demtu bin wagbaut baikwei go insaid po da tent ane demtu bin kabare papa blo demtu. Demtu meke pes blo demtu luk go nadawei solong demtu no go luk papa blo demtu i neketwan.
Wen sens blo Noa i bin kam orait prom dringk, ane em bin paindaut wanem Am, smolboi blo em i bin mekem po em,
em spik:

content.text: ‘Panis i go poldaun antap wea dem pipol blo Kanan, dem pamle blo Am!
Dempla i gobi nambalas sebant blo ol pamlelain blo Sem ane Zapet.’

content: Noa kip spik:

content.text: ‘Mata preize da AntapGod, God blo Sem.
Dem pipol blo Kanan gobi sebant blo Sem.
God, laue dem pamlelain blo Zapet po stap ebriwea lo ert,
Laue dem pamlelain blo Zapet po stap tugeda wea dem pamlelain blo Sem
ane laue Kanan po bi sebant blo Zapet.’

content: Apta wen da prapa big pladwata i bin pinis, Noa bin kipgo po nada 350 iya.
Wen Noa i bin ded, em i bin kese 950 iya oul.
